title: Delphi: Climbing the Sacred Way
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over nine places on the Delphi hillside, in the order a visitor climbs them, to learn what a petitioner or an athlete did at each and what survives today, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

educational.topic: The sanctuary of Apollo at Delphi
learningObjectives: The learner will name nine places on the Delphi hillside in the order a visitor climbs them, say what a petitioner or an athlete did at each, and say what survives to see today.
prerequisites: The sanctuary and the oracle, from [Chapter 17](../../chapters/17-oracle/index.md) and [Chapter 18](../../chapters/18-delphi/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: What did a petitioner or an athlete do here?
commonMisconceptions: The oracle sat in a cave on the plain.
The sanctuary is a flat site.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: identify each marked part from its description

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a marker or label to read about that part.

controls.name: Quiz
controls.description: Hides the labels and asks you to click the marker that matches each description.
